title: Streetwear Brand Launch
description: Launched a new streetwear line with creator-led content that generated 5M+ impressions and 2.5M in first-month sales.

content.challenge: Urban Threads needed to break into the competitive streetwear market with limited marketing budget.
content.solution: We partnered with 15 micro-influencers in the streetwear space to create authentic, native content that resonated with Gen Z audiences.
content.results: The campaign generated 5.2M impressions, 18.5% engagement rate, and $2.5M in first-month sales with an 8.2x ROAS.

title: Tech Product Launch
description: Creator partnerships drove 3M+ video views and 50K+ app downloads in the first week.

content.challenge: TechFlow needed to drive app downloads and user acquisition in a crowded tech market.
content.solution: We created a viral TikTok campaign with tech creators showcasing the app's unique features through entertaining demos.
content.results: Achieved 3.1M video views, 50K+ app downloads, and reduced cost per install by 65%.

title: Beauty Brand Awareness
description: Multi-platform creator campaign increased brand awareness by 400% and drove 1.2M new followers.

content.challenge: Glow Up needed to increase brand awareness and grow their social media following in the competitive beauty space.
content.solution: We executed a multi-platform campaign with beauty creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, focusing on authentic product reviews and tutorials.
content.results: Increased brand awareness by 400%, gained 1.2M new followers, and achieved 22% engagement rate with 45K+ brand mentions.
